newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH NAIL MAKER METALURGIA WANTS TO GO PUBLIC.
newsitem.headline: POLISH NAIL MAKER METALURGIA WANTS TO GO PUBLIC.

text.p: Metalurgia SA, one of Poland's largest nail producers, wants to enter the Warsaw Stock Exchange in the first half of 1998, the company's president said on Wednesday.
"We want to be listed on the bourse in the first half of the next year, but the final decision will be taken in April at the general shareholders' meeting," Jerzy Dworecki told Reuters.
He said that Metalurgia, controlled by the National Investment Fund No. 2, needed to complete restructuring environment protection programmes before going public.
Metalurgia netted 269.000 zlotys in the first three quarters of last year. It exports about 40 percent of its output, mainly to Western Europe.
